The fastest way to set up state is often the API; the truest way to verify what
a customer sees is the web page. Combine them: **create through the API**, then
**verify on the web**. The shop's web and API share one store, so an order
placed through the API appears on its web order page.

## Task 1 — Create an order via the API and verify it on the web

**Goal:** create `checks/combined.robot` that POSTs an order, takes the returned
order id, GETs that order's web page, and asserts it shows as complete.

Here is the same create-then-verify flow over a different order. Adapt it.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     RequestsLibrary
Resource    ../resources/api.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Backpack Order Appears Online
    ${body}=    Create Dictionary    product=trail-backpack    quantity=2
    ${resp}=    POST    ${API_URL}/api/orders    json=${body}
    Status Should Be    201    ${resp}
    ${id}=    Set Variable    ${resp.json()}[id]
    ${page}=    GET    ${WEB_URL}/order/${id}
    Should Contain    ${page.text}    complete
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** the order created via the API is visible on its web page.

<!-- hint -->
POST the order first, then capture its id from the response with
`${id}=    Set Variable    ${resp.json()}[id]`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Use that id to build the web URL: `GET    ${WEB_URL}/order/${id}`, then
`Should Contain    ${page.text}    complete`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     RequestsLibrary
Resource    ../resources/api.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Order Created By Api Shows On The Web
    ${body}=    Create Dictionary    product=travel-mug    quantity=1
    ${resp}=    POST    ${API_URL}/api/orders    json=${body}
    Status Should Be    201    ${resp}
    ${id}=    Set Variable    ${resp.json()}[id]
    ${page}=    GET    ${WEB_URL}/order/${id}
    Should Contain    ${page.text}    complete
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run it green

Run:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

**Check:** the combined test passes end to end.
